title: Uniform-in-time rational approximation of the matrix exponential with real poles
summary: We propose two new approaches for constructing families of rational functions with shared real poles that nearly uniformly approximate the functions $\exp(-tz)$ for $z\geq 0$ and $t$ in a positive time interval. The first result concerns the case where all real poles coalesce into a single point. With an appropriate choice of a weight function we are able to derive a closed formula for the asymptotically optimal location of such a pole.
